title: FB-014 make validation skips explicit failures for release gates
summary: Fixed FR-043, FR-045, and FR-048 by correcting promoted tool discovery and making release/browser validation skips explicit failures for evidence-producing gates.
reason: Worker findings showed validation wrappers could return success when tool, end-to-end, or browser coverage was skipped, and the tool integration gate still used removed layout paths.
behavior_before: Tool integration looked under removed tool/runtime/helper paths and returned success on missing prerequisites. Release self-test skip switches only warned even under required test mode. Browser smoke wrappers directly invoked unittest, so Node or browser prerequisite skips exited successfully.
behavior_after: Tool and end-to-end gates use promoted bundled paths and fail on missing prerequisites unless -AllowMissingTools is explicit. Release self-test tracks skipped/downshifted gates, reports source/dev versus package mode, fails requested skips under -RequireTests, and can fail child checks that emit skip-looking output. Browser smoke wrappers share a runner that fails skipped unittest output unless -AllowSkippedTests is explicit.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-WebViewReliabilityChecks.ps1 now asserts promoted tool paths, release required-mode skip failures, and shared browser wrapper no-skip usage.
